title: Classroom disagreement
bodyMd: A teacher asks pupils to defend positions they do not personally hold. A parent worries that this rewards insincerity. The teacher explains that the exercise is assessed on whether pupils can reconstruct an opposing argument fairly, not whether they persuade classmates to adopt it. Pupils later submit a reflection distinguishing their own view from the assigned one.
